candidates.decision_relevance: Would let reviewers compare the path and event ordering with the weekly summaries, and assess whether rebounds, declines, and reported candidate horizons were represented by endpoints alone.
candidates.evidence_reference: W46 review: raw price path and realized range comparisons absent; W45 review: hourly observations and rebound magnitude absent; W34–W33 reviews: underlying price paths and candidate bounds unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped BTC and ETH spot or mark-price OHLC series
candidates.missing_history_problem: The reviews repeatedly describe intraperiod declines and rebounds but lack aligned historical price observations. Weekly returns and scattered multi-horizon snapshots do not reconstruct path ordering or permit direct comparison to the cited forecast horizons.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would help distinguish sustained participation changes from single-capture or endpoint observations, while preserving the proxy universe and its membership at each observation.
candidates.evidence_reference: W37 reviews: breadth methodology, timestamp, and weekly path absent; daily 2026-11-21 review: breadth is proxy-only with changing point-in-time membership and canonical breadth unconfirmed.
candidates.metric_name: Dated constituent-level breadth observations with universe and membership snapshot
candidates.missing_history_problem: Available breadth descriptions are often endpoints or qualitative summaries, and membership can change between captures. Without a dated historical sequence and constituent universe, persistence and comparability across days cannot be assessed.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow assessment of whether reported flow direction persisted or diverged across assets over the same periods as price and breadth changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: W44 review: latest settled-flow detail is W43, not W44; daily 2026-11-21 and 2026-11-20 reviews: ETF evidence is limited to one settled session.
candidates.metric_name: Dated settled BTC and ETH ETF flow rows, retaining reported units and source/session dates
